sourceDecision: Retain production. All three scoped literal caller arrays are nonempty: mounts declare name/Mount, namespaces/Namespaces, revision/Revision with only revision explicitly number; paths declare path/Logical path, namespace/Namespace, name/Secret, fieldCount/Fields and retention/Retention with the last two explicitly number; selected field mappings declare field/Logical field and key/Exact native key without explicit sort kinds. Their first declared keys are name, path and field respectively. MetadataTable types columns as an ordinary array with optional sort, reads columns[0].key for useSort and finds the selected column by exact key. The ordinary array type does not itself enforce nonemptiness, while these three literal callers supply it. useSort declares its state initialized to defaultKey and asc; compareValues declares text and asc defaults and receives column?.sort and sortDir. Omitted sort fields are literal omissions; no comparator/hook/default-argument evaluation, sorting, rendering, remount or changing-column state behavior is qualified. Exact labels, keys, row projections/IDs, direction/comparator/tie-breaker and post-sort100 slice remain unchanged. Targeted saved metadata-announcements and metadata-success select public functions without the real table/helper/hook/comparator and substitute a props-only metadata-table or string placeholder. They do not qualify actual table sorting or runtime values. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
